'''Medical Unit AZ-01''' was a [[Medical droid/Legends|medical droid]] used by [[Arlaia Zayzen]], a gladiator in the [[Arena Grand]] of [[Zakuul]]. Along with other droids such as [[Combat Unit AZ-02]], [[Advanced Combat Unit AZ-03]], [[Assault Unit AZ-A]] and [[Assault Unit AZ-B]], this droid was designated after Arlaia's own initials and assisted her during the fights. In [[3630 BBY]] Arlaia was put up against a newcomer known as "[[Alliance Commander|the Mysterious Stranger]]," who defeated her along with Medical Unit AZ-01 in the first round of the Arena fights.<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Medical Unit AZ-01 appears in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Knights of the Fallen Empire]]'' as part of the first boss fight of the "Eternal Championship."
